findings.passage: House Bill 958 is absolutely full of ways to make it harder to vote.
findings.note: Campaign-site Instagram feed post (the date is the feed timestamp). She describes House Bill 958 as an election-law bill with early voting cuts, easier vote challenges, voter registration hurdles and less campaign finance transparency, notes the governor vetoed it, and asks supporters to press to uphold the veto. The post does not mention voter ID.

She is a listed co-sponsor (not primary) of Senate Bill 715, Student Voter ID Grant Program/CCs. The bill text gives community colleges grants of up to $20,000 each to upgrade equipment to produce student ID cards that can be used to vote in person under G.S. 163-166.16. Last action: re-referred to Appropriations/Base Budget on 3/26/2025.
subjects: student ID cards used as voter ID

findings.passage: I introduced legislation to make early registration possible for 16 and 17-year-olds (S385) and to make voter registration automatic (S45).
findings.note: In her Indy Week 2026 candidate questionnaire she lists registration bills under making it easier to vote. Date is approximate (the paper's Q&A is cited in February 2026). No mention of photo ID or proof of citizenship.
